mapper.insert: INSERT INTO proj_project_task_assignment (id, project_task_id, assignee_user_id, effective_from, effective_to, assigned_by, reason, version, creator, updater, tenant_id) VALUES (#{assignment.id}, #{assignment.projectTaskId}, #{assignment.assigneeUserId}, #{assignment.effectiveFrom}, #{assignment.effectiveTo}, #{assignment.assignedBy}, #{assignment.reason}, #{assignment.version}, #{assignment.creator}, #{assignment.updater}, #{assignment.tenantId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM proj_project_task_assignment WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND project_task_id = #{query.projectTaskId} AND current_marker = 1 AND effective_to IS NULL AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE
